title: Beacon freshness
text: Beacon marks a sensor stale after 45 seconds without a sample. A stale sample cannot support a capacity decision.

title: Lumen timestamps
text: Lumen stores capture time and arrival time separately. Its freshness rule uses capture time.

title: Reef clock check
text: Reef rejects a sample captured more than five seconds in the future. It records the clock error without changing the sample.

title: Tide gaps
text: Tide retains a missing interval as unknown. It does not interpolate a healthy reading across the gap.

title: Harbor revision
text: Harbor serves only the revision named in the signed manifest. A newer filename alone does not update the active revision.

title: Quay supersession
text: Quay retains superseded notes for audit. Search results identify the selected revision and its effective date.

title: Buoy conflicts
text: Buoy flags contradictory revisions for review. It never merges conflicting instructions silently.

title: Pier document hash
text: Pier verifies each document hash before indexing. A mismatched document stops readiness.

title: Jetty queue
text: Jetty admits at most eight waiting requests per worker. Further requests receive an explicit overload rejection.

title: Cove deadlines
text: Cove measures deadlines from scheduled arrival. A delayed dispatch does not grant a later deadline.

title: Dune retries
text: Dune records every physical attempt. A logical retry does not remove the original timeout from the ledger.

title: Shoal drain
text: Shoal stops new arrivals during its final drain. Work unfinished at the drain deadline remains unfinished in the report.

title: Atlas bundle
text: Atlas identifies a model by revision and hashes of all executed files. The package version alone is insufficient.

title: Kelp provider
text: Kelp records the CPU execution provider and thread count. A provider change requires a new environment record.

title: Foam parity
text: Foam compares direct and served embeddings with an absolute tolerance of one hundred-thousandth. Different ranked IDs fail parity.

title: Mast cache
text: Mast keeps weights loaded but disables query-result caches during measurement. Each successful request invokes the encoder.

title: Skiff readiness
text: Skiff becomes ready only after loading its model, validating the corpus and completing an encoder probe. Liveness alone is insufficient.

title: Sail replacement
text: Sail records the lost pod UID and its replacement UID. Recovery requires a fresh inference from the replacement.

title: Dock shutdown
text: Dock stops admission before draining in-flight work. Its termination budget is thirty seconds.

title: Channel capacity
text: Channel distinguishes desired replicas from ready replicas. A pending pod contributes no ready capacity.

title: Anchor raw data
text: Anchor retains failed runs alongside successful runs. Its inventory determines the denominator.

title: Lagoon expiry
text: Lagoon expires public receipts after twenty-four hours. Expired sessions cannot read those receipts.

title: Breakwater secrets
text: Breakwater excludes credentials and cluster configuration from public artifacts. It publishes sanitized identities only.

title: Estuary rederive
text: Estuary regenerates reports from raw evidence in a clean checkout. Changed input hashes invalidate the accepted summary.
